sets.name: Modal
sets.desc: Modal is a popup window that appears on top of the main screen to grab user attention for immediate actions or input. It often contains focused content like forms or alerts and blocks interaction with the background until dismissed. Modals are useful for tasks needing user confirmation, feedback, or critical alerts, helping to keep focus and simplify interaction.

doc: A modal is a secondary window that communicates or provides an action inside the same process. They’re incredibly useful for communicating additional information, collecting information, or directing users without forcing them to leave the page. When modals are used unnecessarily, they can become intrusive and annoying for the user. Nobody likes pop-ups.
